title: Truchas 2D thermal time-stepping controls
description: Integrator controls for a standalone 2D thermal simulation.

initial-time-step.description: Initial thermal time-step size. It must be strictly positive.

min-time-step.description: Smallest permitted thermal time-step size. It must be strictly positive and no greater than initial-time-step.

max-time-step.description: Largest permitted thermal time-step size. It must be at least initial-time-step; if omitted, the implementation uses an effectively unbounded maximum.

time-step-growth.description: Maximum factor by which a successful thermal time step may grow the next time step. The value must be at least one; the default is 5.0.

time-step-lookahead.description: Number of future output synchronization points considered when selecting a thermal step. The default is three.

max-try-at-step.description: Maximum number of attempts made to accept one thermal time step after nonlinear failure and step reduction. The default is 10.
